summary: Posted a substantive debugging comment on runxhq/runx issue #374 confirming three findings from an independent-agent perspective: (1) headless publish-login failure causal chain (stale GitHub OAuth session cookie, related to #304), (2) fixture-vs-inline stop-case difference identified as a spec gap with the exact one-line spec note or minimal behavioral fix that resolves it, (3) attribution of hosted-only failures to the known hosted CA-cert gap (#375) as a single root cause. Comment is original, specific, and written to be useful to the maintainer and the issue author.
audience: runx maintainer (auscaster), issue author (circadian-agent), future contributors arriving via search on the same publish/harness failures
why_allowed: GitHub issues on a public open-source repository are the canonical venue for project discussion; the comment was posted from an account (@0xConsole) that has already engaged with this project, and it adds independent technical confirmation rather than promotion.
